ja265:1.1: “Seeing arrows impelled with speed from bow,
ja265:1.2: The sharp, tempered swords that were held aloft,
ja265:1.3: When there was an imminent fear of death,
ja265:1.4: Why did you not speak about your terror?”
ja265:2.1: “Seeing arrows impelled with speed from bow,
ja265:2.2: The sharp, tempered swords that were held aloft,
ja265:2.3: When there was an imminent fear of death,
ja265:3.1: Being inspired I conquered (all) my foes,
ja265:3.2: Formerly I abandoned this my life,
ja265:3.3: Being attached to his life, the hero
ja265:3.4: Sometimes does not do a hero’s duty.”
